pages.title: Sovereign Vanguard · Private Technology & Concierge MSP
pages.description: Private technology management and concierge managed services for businesses, executives, families and fiduciary offices. One relationship. Defined responsibility.

hero.h1: Technology managed with authority. Service delivered with care.
hero.lede: One accountable relationship for your business, executive or private-office technology. We coordinate and manage everything included in your agreement. You retain ownership and approval.
hero.next: Start with your needs. Agree the scope before work begins.

sections.h2: One relationship. Defined responsibility. Exceptional care.
paras: You should not have to manage the people who manage your technology. The proposed concierge model gives you one relationship owner to coordinate included work, keep you informed and bring decisions back to you.

cards.title: A single accountable relationship
cards.body: One clearly identified person owns coordination, even when several specialists or vendors are needed behind the scenes.

cards.title: Everything in your agreement, managed
cards.body: Within the package you choose, the work is owned end to end. You are not asked to coordinate each task.

cards.title: Proactive stewardship
cards.body: Monitoring, preventive maintenance and planned reviews, rather than waiting for something to break.

sections.h2: Less coordination for you. Clear ownership of the work.
sections.intro: When several vendors are involved, responsibility should still be easy to follow.

items.title: You bring the need
items.body: One relationship owner receives your request and confirms what falls within the agreement.

items.title: We coordinate the included work
items.body: Relevant specialists and vendors are coordinated, with progress and the next step explained plainly.

items.title: You keep the decisions
items.body: Your systems remain yours. Material changes, extra scope and access require the agreed approvals.

sections.h2: For those who carry responsibility for others

cards.title: Businesses
cards.body: Small and midsize organizations that want one accountable technology partner.

cards.title: Executives and boards

cards.title: Private and family offices
cards.body: Private clients, executive households and family offices, including multiple locations where contracted.

cards.title: Trustees and governing bodies

cards.label: SV · Concierge
cards.title: Personal coordination
cards.body: Relationship management, executive support, vendor coordination and clear service communication.

cards.label: SV · Guardian

cards.label: SV · Advisory

sections.h2: A clear path from first conversation to steady stewardship

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: A discreet conversation about your people, locations, systems and concerns.

steps.title: Define
steps.body: What is included, excluded and conditional, written down before work begins.

steps.title: Onboard
steps.body: Secure access, an agreed inventory and a named relationship owner.

steps.title: Steward
steps.body: Proactive care and coordination, with updates at the cadence you prefer.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Regular reviews in plain language; scope adjusted only by written agreement.

paras: Protection, privacy and reliability sit at the centre of the service. We describe the safeguards that are actually in your agreement, and we never promise that nothing can go wrong. When something does, you hear what is known, what is not yet known and what happens next.

link.label: How we approach security and privacy

sections.title: What "everything" means here
sections.body: When we say we take care of everything, we mean everything included in the agreement you choose: defined, documented and never unlimited. You keep ownership of your systems, your decisions and your approvals.

hero.h1: Discreet care for the people and organizations entrusted to you.
hero.lede: Our clients carry responsibility for businesses, families and records. We take the technology off their list, within the agreement they choose.

paras: Small and midsize organizations, owners, executive teams and board members who want one accountable partner across routine operations and higher-trust work.
list: One relationship owner instead of a ticket queue

pages.title: Our Approach · Sovereign Vanguard
pages.description: The Sovereign Standard: personal stewardship, proactive protection, concierge coordination, complete management within scope, discretion and accountability.

hero.h1: A private technology office, delivered as a managed service.
hero.lede: You should receive decisions, outcomes and concise communication, not a pile of tickets and vendor hand-offs.

cards.title: Personal stewardship
cards.body: An accountable relationship owner is assigned to you.

cards.title: Proactive protection
cards.body: Contracted monitoring and risk reduction run continuously or at agreed intervals.

cards.title: Concierge experience
cards.body: We coordinate and communicate instead of sending you between teams.

cards.title: Complete management
cards.body: Work within your package is owned from start to finish.

cards.title: Discretion and privacy
cards.body: Access and information are controlled and kept confidential.

cards.title: Accountability
cards.body: Commitments, escalations and outcomes are documented.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: A discreet enquiry and a confidential first conversation. We confirm who may contract and decide.

steps.title: Define
steps.body: With your permission, we take stock of systems, vendors and risks, then record what is included, excluded and conditional.

steps.title: Onboard
steps.body: Agreement signed, relationship owner named, access set up securely with least privilege, and a baseline inventory agreed.

steps.title: Steward
steps.body: Requests and events are triaged, coordinated and resolved, with status at the cadence you choose.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Regular reviews of activity, risks and priorities, in plain language. Scope changes only by written agreement.

sections.h2: Many specialists. One person who answers for them.
paras: Behind a well-run environment there may be several specialists, manufacturers and service providers. You should not have to manage them. Your relationship owner coordinates the work, confirms with you before any material change, and keeps an audit trail of what was done and why.
If you ever decide to leave, the exit is planned too: your records exported, credentials and assets handed over securely, and our access removed and documented.

pages.title: Security & Privacy · Sovereign Vanguard
pages.description: How Sovereign Vanguard approaches protection, privacy and incidents: practices defined in each agreement, with no absolute promises.

hero.lede: Your agreement sets out the safeguards that apply to you. Here is how we think about them.

sections.h2: What our protection is built around
sections.draft: Draft for the concept. The final list will name only the controls in operation at launch.

cards.title: Access, deliberately
cards.body: Multifactor authentication and least-privilege access for client and provider accounts, reviewed regularly.

cards.title: Separation
cards.body: Client environments kept apart, with privileged access managed with care.

cards.title: Known and maintained
cards.body: Device and software inventory, patching, endpoint protection and secure configuration.

cards.title: Recoverable
cards.body: Clear ownership of backups, agreed recovery objectives and restore testing.

cards.title: Vendors checked
cards.body: Due diligence on third parties, and your explicit approval before data is shared.

cards.title: Changes approved
cards.body: Your written approval before material, disruptive or higher-risk changes.

paras: Incidents are classified and escalated according to your agreement. You are told what is known, what is not yet known and what happens next, without speculation. Evidence is preserved, and the people you have authorized are kept informed.

cols.title: No absolute promises
list: No one can guarantee that every incident is prevented
No promise of total privacy or perfect uptime
No round-the-clock human response unless your agreement includes it

cols.title: No borrowed credentials
list: We list certifications and compliance status only once they are held
Regulated obligations are reviewed with your own advisers
Technology services are not legal, investment or fiduciary advice

pages.title: Privacy, Terms and Accessibility · Sovereign Vanguard
pages.description: Privacy policy, terms of use and accessibility statement for the Sovereign Vanguard website.

sections.draft: Draft for the concept. Final wording follows legal review and will name the correct legal entity.

paras: This concept does not send or save form entries and uses no advertising trackers. Google Fonts is requested by your browser to display the proposed typefaces. Before launch, the final privacy notice must describe the actual enquiry provider, recipients, retention and legal operator.
Please do not send passwords, account numbers or sensitive records through this website.

The information on this website is general. It is not an offer of service, and it is not legal, investment or fiduciary advice. Services are provided only under a signed agreement that sets out what is included.

We aim for this website to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA: it works with a keyboard, with screen readers, at 320 px wide and when zoomed. If anything is difficult to use, please tell us through the contact page and we will help.
